_how: Every item that can be found on the site. The key (e.g. "test_token") is the item's id: use it in data-item="..." on a page, in a frequency code's {"type": "item", "id": "..."} action, or in Marquez's "give". Fields: name (shown on the found slip and in the drawer), desc (shown when you hover it in the drawer; \n for a new line), art (an image, ideally a transparent SVG or PNG under /backstage/drawer/art/), size (how big it lies in the drawer: 1 is normal, 0.7 small, 1.4 large), found (optional: the small line on the found slip, default "into the drawer"). Items not listed here still go in the drawer, as a plain paper tag with their id. Items without art show as a blank tag with their name until art exists. SHAKING: "shakes": {"into": "other_id", "times": 14} means shaking it in the drawer (dragging it back and forth, or tapping it fast) that many times in a row turns it into <into>. Stop for a few seconds and it settles back down. "spot": "other_id" makes an item lie where that other item lay in the drawer. RECIPES (Cedar's workbench, once he has seen the Bright Bulb): each recipe is {"use": [two item ids, any order], "make": "new_id", "say": "Cedar dialogue node he says after"}. Both items in "use" are used up; the Bright Bulb is the light you work by and is never used up. Used-up items never come back.

pail.name: Pail
pail.desc:
Empty, but the bottom's still damp.
Two kids took it up a hill for water once. They both came tumbling down. The pail stayed up there.

rusted_key.name: Rusted Key
rusted_key.desc:
Rusted almost solid. It opened a front door once, to a warm house with somebody waiting inside.
Nobody remembers the street now. Somebody kept the key anyway.

tiny_tombstone.name: Tiny Tombstone
tiny_tombstone.desc:
For the little ones. Twenty-five of them, and counting.
Someone carved GONE BUT NOT FORGOTTEN. Someone else scratched out the NOT.

popup_shard.name: Popup Shard
popup_shard.desc:
A sliver of a window that wouldn't close.
Still warm. Still blinking, a little.

dead_bulb.name: Dead Bulb
dead_bulb.desc:
Burnt out. Found in the dark, which is the only place you'd ever find it.
Shake it and something rattles.

polaroid.name: Polaroid
polaroid.desc:
A dark photo of... him???
On the back, in shaky pen: 'don't trust the' and the rest is torn away.

todd_floppy.name: TODD's Floppy Disk
todd_floppy.desc:
TODD.OS BOOT DISK 1 OF ??
The label is in all caps, then no caps, then all caps again.

static_cassette.name: Static Cassette
static_cassette.desc:
No label. Play it and you'd only hear static.
Probably.

bright_bulb.name: Bright Bulb
bright_bulb.desc:
It glows now. Nobody plugged it in.
Shake it and the rattle's gone. Whatever was in there, it's the light now.

clear_polaroid.name: Clear Polaroid
clear_polaroid.desc:
The dark photo, looked at through a dead eye.
You can see it all now. You'd rather you couldn't.

dubbed_tape.name: Dubbed Tape
dubbed_tape.desc:
Side A: static. Side B: something out of TODD's disk.
It's warm. Cassettes shouldn't be warm.

hill_marker.name: Hill Marker
hill_marker.desc:
The tiny tombstone, gone green and grown into the shape of a hill.
Two names scratched into it: JACK. JILL.
